figurative_meaning_en: Useless thing, worthless or invalid item
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই পুরনো ফোনটা পচা আদা, ফেলে দাও।
সেই আইডিয়াটা পচা আলুর মতো অকেজো।
example_sentences_in_english: This old phone is rotten ginger, just throw it away.
That idea is as useless as a rotten potato.
note: The idiom draws from rural Bengali life where perishable vegetables and items quickly become unusable, emphasizing waste and obsolescence.
